messages:
mike: FYI hit an assert in allocator drain under prefetch stress. dumping notes here so we can triage.

tara: which assert and stack?

mike: "drain: outstanding reservations == 0 failed" at alloc.cc:421, stack points to prefetch_completion_cb -> worker_thread. repro on staging with tools/prefetch_stress --clients=200 --seq=8192.

jia: only staging? any unit repro?

mike: flaky on staging, added a tight toggle harness that flakes in ~1h. refcounts show 1->0 inside callback but drain sees 0 and asserts.

sam: sounds like a snapshot race between drain and callback handoff.

tara: quick fix: handshake. drain sets draining flag; callbacks check flag and if set increment a short-lived counter before touching allocator, decrement on exit. drain waits for counter==0 after setting flag.

jia: long-term we should require a lightweight lease for any code touching allocator state; this handshake buys time.

mike: I'll draft a PR with draining flag + callback-hold counter + unit test + telemetry + rollback feature-flag. request review once up.

infra-bot: scheduled canary rollout for branch mike/prefetch-drain-fix on cluster:staging-canary at 2026-04-02T09:00Z :white_check_mark:

sam: include backtrace sampling when drain waits >10ms and a canary kill-switch.

tara: add debug tracepoints for start/end drain with sampled counters.

mike: noted, opening PR today and will paste link here.
